# Pure-Go race builds must ignore the ThreadSanitizer system object selected
# by the target's GOOS and GOARCH.

env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux

env GOARCH=amd64
go list -race -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_kolkov_import\.go( |$)'
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .

env GOARCH=arm64
go list -race -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_kolkov_import\.go( |$)'
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .
go list -race -f '{{join .IgnoredOtherFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_linux_arm64\.syso( |$)'

env GOARCH=loong64
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .
go list -race -f '{{join .IgnoredOtherFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_linux_loong64\.syso( |$)'

env GOARCH=ppc64le
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .
go list -race -f '{{join .IgnoredOtherFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_linux_ppc64le\.syso( |$)'

env GOARCH=riscv64
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .
go list -race -f '{{join .IgnoredOtherFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_linux_riscv64\.syso( |$)'

env GOARCH=s390x
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .
go list -race -f '{{join .IgnoredOtherFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_linux_s390x\.syso( |$)'

# Enabling cgo must preserve selection of the ThreadSanitizer system object.
env CGO_ENABLED=1 GOARCH=arm64
go list -race -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout 'race_kolkov_import\.go'
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '^race_linux_arm64\.syso$'

# Apply the same selection rules to the Darwin system object.
env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout .
go list -race -f '{{join .IgnoredOtherFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '(^| )race_darwin_arm64\.syso( |$)'

env CGO_ENABLED=1
go list -race -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout 'race_kolkov_import\.go'
go list -race -f '{{join .SysoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
stdout '^race_darwin_arm64\.syso$'

# Ordinary builds must not select the Kolkov package import at all.
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go list -f '{{join .GoFiles " "}}' runtime/race
! stdout 'race_kolkov_import\.go'
